title: 查询账户及开户人
objective: 用客户编号为每个符合余额条件的账户查出开户人。
statement: 列出余额达到 30000 元的账户及其开户人，正好 30000 元也算，冻结账户符合余额条件也要列出。依次输出 account_id（账户编号）、customer_name（客户姓名）、balance（余额，元）、status（账户状态）。每个账户一行，行顺序不限。
knowledge: accounts.customer_id 是外键，引用 customers.id。每个账户都有且只有一名开户客户；同一客户可以有多个账户。
JOIN 是 INNER JOIN 的简写，按 ON 条件配对，只保留配得上的行。accounts AS a 和 customers AS c 为两张表起短名：a.id 是账户编号，c.id 是客户编号，姓名来自 c.name。
预览里账户 1 和 11 属于同一位张伟，账户 4 属于另一位同名客户。查开户人应按编号配对；上述三条账户记录各占一行。
starterSql: -- 关联账户与客户，只保留余额不低于 30000 元的账户。

hints.text: 沿着账户上登记的客户编号去找开户人。对一下两张表，看看哪个 id 属于账户、哪个属于人。
FROM 账户表 AS a JOIN 客户表 AS c ON 两个客户编号相等；用 别名.列名 取字段。
SELECT a.id AS account_id, c.name AS customer_name, a.balance, a.status FROM accounts AS a JOIN ____ ON ____ WHERE a.balance >= 30000;

referenceSolutions.sql: SELECT a.id AS account_id, c.name AS customer_name, a.balance, a.status FROM accounts AS a JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = a.customer_id WHERE a.balance >= 30000;
referenceSolutions.explanation: ON 按客户编号补上姓名，WHERE 按账户余额选行。预览中 5 号账户虽然冻结，但余额刚好达到 30000 元，仍然列出。

expectedFailures.sql: SELECT a.id AS account_id, c.name AS customer_name, a.balance, a.status FROM accounts AS a JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = a.customer_id;
SELECT a.id AS account_id, c.name AS customer_name, a.balance, a.status FROM accounts AS a JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = a.customer_id WHERE a.balance > 30000;
SELECT a.id AS account_id, c.name AS customer_name, a.balance, a.status FROM accounts AS a JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = a.id WHERE a.balance >= 30000;
